example.title: Rio Vista public boat launching facility

brief: A public boat launch of the 2000s-2010s: a wide concrete launch ramp with grooved surface running down into the water between low rip-rap banks, a floating boarding dock with a chain-link-railed gangway alongside, a stepped concrete path and a cast-concrete sign panel on a river-cobble bed ('Boat launching facility, funded by the Harbors and Watercraft revolving fund'), lamp standards and a parking area. Two photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
